title: Tesla is inviting some people to buy a Cybercab ‘for personal use’ — but read the fine print
summary: The inclusion of a mandatory $299/month subscription is sure to rankle some fans who may have dreamed of cruising around in a $30,000 driverless Tesla, as originally promised by Tesla CEO Elon Musk when he first introduced the Cybercab in 2024.
